title: Arrakis · Overview
description: The whole server at a glance: state, players, tick rate, load, temperature, storage and alerts (meta#99). Private.

panels.title: Server
panels.description: Overall state according to the console API.

panels.title: Players online
panels.description: Players online now (console API).

panels.title: Server tick rate
panels.description: Slowest map server over 5 minutes, in ticks per second. The target is 20; below 18 players feel rubberbanding.

panels.title: Busiest map thread
panels.description: Highest main-thread CPU of any map (1.0 = one core). Above 0.9 is a burst.

panels.title: Guest CPU
panels.description: Average busy share across the 60 vCPUs of the game server VM.

panels.title: Guest memory
panels.description: Share of the game server VM's memory in use.

panels.title: Hottest sensor
panels.description: Hottest host temperature sensor.

panels.title: VM disk pool used
panels.description: Share used of the Proxmox thin pool that holds the VM disks. A full pool freezes every VM on it.

panels.title: Host storage used
panels.description: Share used of the host's root storage.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Alerts firing now, not counting the two known and silenced ones (cAdvisor and RabbitMQ heartbeats).

panels.title: Maps ready
panels.description: Game-server partitions reporting ready (dynamic ones may be stopped on purpose).

panels.title: Queue backlog
panels.description: Messages waiting in RabbitMQ across both brokers. Zero is healthy.

panels.title: Internet down
panels.description: Download traffic through the gateway's internet port now (1 min).

panels.title: Internet up
panels.description: Upload traffic through the gateway's internet port now (1 min). This is the direction game traffic to players uses.

panels.title: Internet use
panels.description: The busier direction as a share of the 2000 Mbit/s plan.

panels.title: Internet latency
panels.description: Latency from the gateway to the internet, as the gateway measures it.

panels.title: Internet port
panels.description: Whether the gateway's internet port is up.

panels.title: Last speed test
panels.description: Download speed of the gateway's most recent speed test (Mbit/s); the upload result is on the host dashboard's Internet row.

panels.title: Server tick rate per map
panels.description: Ticks per second of each map server, from the game's own log. The target is 20.

panels.title: Players online
panels.description: Players online now, from the console API.

panels.title: Main thread CPU per map
panels.description: The game's main thread per map is single-threaded, so this is the limit. 1.0 means one core saturated; the red line is the 0.9 burst threshold.

panels.title: Host temperatures
panels.description: Hottest and average host temperature sensor.
